I'm working on the experiment page sidebar navigation in MLflow and I've noticed that time range filter parameters get dropped when switching between certain tabs.

*   When navigating between traces-related tabs (such as Overview, Sessions, Traces, and Chat Sessions), the sidebar navigation links must preserve ALL current URL query parameters in their href, including both time range parameters (e.g. startTimeLabel, startTime) and traces-specific parameters (e.g. selectedTraceId).

*   When navigating from a traces-related tab to a non-traces-related tab (such as Datasets), the navigation link href must include time range parameters (e.g. startTimeLabel) from the current URL but must NOT include traces-specific parameters (e.g. selectedTraceId).

*   When navigating from a non-traces-related tab to a traces-related tab (such as Traces), the navigation link href must include time range parameters (e.g. startTimeLabel) from the current URL but must NOT include tab-specific parameters (e.g. selectedDatasetId).

*   When navigating between non-traces-related tabs (e.g. from Datasets to Judges), the navigation link href must include time range parameters (e.g. startTimeLabel) from the current URL but must NOT include any other tab-specific parameters (e.g. selectedDatasetId, viewMode).

*   Time range parameters that qualify for cross-tab preservation include at minimum startTimeLabel and startTime; all other non-time-range parameters are considered tab-specific and must be dropped when navigating outside their applicable tab group.

The verification system will apply test patches automatically.

I now have a thorough understanding of the sidebar navigation. Here is my report.

## Summary

The experiment page sidebar navigation exists in **two parallel implementations** that share the same config and the same `getExperimentPageTabRoute` route builder and the same `preserveQueryParams` logic:

1. **`ExperimentPageSideNav`** — the primary in-page side nav (used inside `ExperimentPageTabs.tsx`).
2. **`MlflowSidebarExperimentItems`** — the global left sidebar's experiment section (used inside `MlflowSidebar.tsx`).

Both build links to tabs like Overview, Traces, Sessions (Chat Sessions), Datasets, Judges, Evaluation runs, Prompts, Agent versions/Models, Runs.

## 1. Sidebar nav rendering components

- **`/workspace/repo/mlflow/server/js/src/experiment-tracking/pages/experiment-page-tabs/side-nav/ExperimentPageSideNav.tsx`** — top-level side nav container; picks config via `useExperimentPageSideNavConfig`, maps sections to `ExperimentPageSideNavSection`.
- **`/workspace/repo/mlflow/server/js/src/experiment-tracking/pages/experiment-page-tabs/side-nav/ExperimentPageSideNavSection.tsx`** — renders each section's item links (the actual `<Link>` per tab). **This is where hrefs are constructed** (lines 80–96).
- **`/workspace/repo/mlflow/server/js/src/experiment-tracking/pages/experiment-page-tabs/side-nav/constants.tsx`** — defines the tab items (label, icon, tabName, componentId) and the `useExperimentPageSideNavConfig` hook. Overview/Judges are feature-flag gated (`shouldEnableExperimentOverviewTab()`, `enableScorersUI()`).
- **`/workspace/repo/mlflow/server/js/src/experiment-tracking/pages/experiment-page-tabs/side-nav/utils.tsx`** — `isTracesRelatedTab()` helper.
- **`/workspace/repo/mlflow/server/js/src/experiment-tracking/pages/experiment-page-tabs/side-nav/ExperimentPageSideNavAssistantButton.tsx`** — assistant button at bottom (not a tab link).
- **`/workspace/repo/mlflow/server/js/src/common/components/MlflowSidebarExperimentItems.tsx`** — the global sidebar's experiment nav; renders `MlflowSidebarLink` per tab (hrefs constructed at lines 99–102).
- **`/workspace/repo/mlflow/server/js/src/common/components/MlflowSidebarLink.tsx`** — generic sidebar link wrapper around `<Link>`.
- **`/workspace/repo/mlflow/server/js/src/common/components/MlflowSidebar.tsx`** (renders `MlflowSidebarExperimentItems` at line 162).

## 2. How hrefs / URLs are constructed

Both components build the `to` prop as an object with `pathname` + optional `search`:

`ExperimentPageSideNavSection.tsx` (lines 78–86):
```tsx
const preserveQueryParams = isTracesRelatedTab(activeTab) && isTracesRelatedTab(item.tabName);
...
to={{
  pathname: Routes.getExperimentPageTabRoute(experimentId, item.tabName),
  search: preserveQueryParams ? search : undefined,
}}
```

`MlflowSidebarExperimentItems.tsx` (lines 93–102) — identical logic, using `activeTabByRoute` from `useGetExperimentPageActiveTabByRoute()`:
```tsx
const preserveQueryParams =
  activeTabByRoute && isTracesRelatedTab(activeTabByRoute) && isTracesRelatedTab(item.tabName);
...
to={{
  pathname: ExperimentTrackingRoutes.getExperimentPageTabRoute(experimentId ?? '', item.tabName),
  search: preserveQueryParams ? search : undefined,
}}
```

Key behavior: the current URL query string (`search` from `useLocation()`) is forwarded **only when both the active tab and the target tab are "traces-related"** (Overview, Traces, ChatSessions, SingleChatSession — see `utils.tsx`). Otherwise `search` is `undefined` and all query params are dropped on navigation.

The pathname builder is in **`/workspace/repo/mlflow/server/js/src/experiment-tracking/routes.ts`**:
- Line 178–180: `getExperimentPageTabRoute(experimentId, tabName)` → `generatePath(RoutePaths.experimentPageTabbed, {experimentId, tabName})`. Route template `mlflow.experiment.details.tab` (line 14 / getter at line 86). Note: it does **not** add any query params.
- Line 182–184: `getExperimentPageTabSingleChatSessionRoute`.

`ExperimentPageTabName` enum: `/workspace/repo/mlflow/server/js/src/experiment-tracking/constants.ts:141` (overview, runs, traces, models, judges, evaluation-runs, datasets, chat-sessions, prompts, etc.).

## 3. Where the query params (startTimeLabel, startTime, selectedTraceId, selectedDatasetId, viewMode) live

There is **no** helper that builds tab hrefs *with* these params — they are only preserved opaquely via the raw `search` string. The params themselves are owned by separate hooks/constants:

- **startTimeLabel / startTime / endTime** — `/workspace/repo/mlflow/server/js/src/experiment-tracking/hooks/useMonitoringFilters.tsx`
  - `START_TIME_LABEL_QUERY_PARAM_KEY = 'startTimeLabel'` (line 9), `START_TIME_QUERY_PARAM_KEY = 'startTime'` (line 10), `END_TIME_QUERY_PARAM_KEY = 'endTime'` (line 11). `DEFAULT_START_TIME_LABEL = 'LAST_7_DAYS'` (line 21). Read/write via `useSearchParams` (lines 56–103).

Used to build trace deep-links in `ModelTraceHeaderSessionIdTag.tsx:36` and `SessionIdLinkWrapper.tsx:23` (via `new URLSearchParams({ [SELECTED_TRACE_ID_QUERY_PARAM]: traceId })`).
- **selectedDatasetId** — `/workspace/repo/mlflow/server/js/src/experiment-tracking/pages/experiment-evaluation-datasets/hooks/useSelectedDatasetBySearchParam.ts:4` (`SELECTED_DATASET_ID_QUERY_PARAM_KEY = 'selectedDatasetId'`).
- **viewMode** — `useExperimentLoggedModelListPageMode.tsx:9` (`VIEW_MODE_QUERY_PARAM = 'viewMode'`) and `experiment-evaluation-runs/hooks/useExperimentEvaluationRunsPageMode.tsx:9` (`MODE_SEARCH_KEY = 'viewMode'`).

Auto-navigation to default tab: **`/workspace/repo/mlflow/server/js/src/experiment-tracking/components/experiment-page/hooks/useNavigateToExperimentPageTab.tsx`** (line 66 uses `getExperimentPageTabRoute`, no query params).

## 4. Existing helpers for building URLs / preserving query params

- `getExperimentPageTabRoute` / `getExperimentPageTabSingleChatSessionRoute` / `getExperimentPageTracesTabRoute` — in `routes.ts` (pathname only, no query params).
- `isTracesRelatedTab(tabName)` — in `side-nav/utils.tsx` — the sole gate for whether query params are preserved across tab navigation.
- There is **no** dedicated helper that constructs a tab href *including* startTimeLabel/startTime/selectedTraceId/etc. Preservation is done inline (the `search: preserveQueryParams ? search : undefined` pattern) in both `ExperimentPageSideNavSection.tsx` and `MlflowSidebarExperimentItems.tsx`.

The implementation is complete. Let me summarize what I changed.

## Summary

The sidebar navigation was using an all-or-nothing rule: it forwarded the **entire** URL query string only when *both* the active tab and the target tab were traces-related, and dropped **everything** otherwise. That's why time-range filters (`startTimeLabel`, `startTime`) got lost whenever navigation crossed the traces/non-traces boundary or moved between two non-traces tabs.

I replaced that boolean with a shared helper, `getPreservedSearchParams`, that implements the per-param rule from the spec.

### Files changed (source only — no tests touched)

1. **`experiment-page-tabs/side-nav/utils.tsx`** — Added `getPreservedSearchParams(search, activeTab, targetTab)`:
   - Both tabs traces-related → return the **full** query string (preserves time-range *and* traces-specific params like `selectedTraceId`).
   - Otherwise → return **only** the time-range params (`startTimeLabel`, `startTime`, `endTime`), dropping all tab-specific params (`selectedTraceId`, `selectedDatasetId`, `viewMode`, …).
   - Returns `undefined` when nothing remains.

2. **`hooks/useMonitoringFilters.tsx`** — Exported `START_TIME_QUERY_PARAM_KEY` and `END_TIME_QUERY_PARAM_KEY` (already the source of truth for these keys) so the helper reuses them instead of hard-coding strings. `START_TIME_LABEL_QUERY_PARAM_KEY` was already exported.

3. **`ExperimentPageSideNavSection.tsx`** (in-page side nav) and **`common/components/MlflowSidebarExperimentItems.tsx`** (global left sidebar) — Both now build the link's `search` via `getPreservedSearchParams(...)` instead of the old `preserveQueryParams ? search : undefined`.

This covers all five requirements: traces↔traces preserves all params; every cross-group and non-traces↔non-traces navigation preserves time-range params while dropping tab-specific ones.

`yarn type-check` passes clean. The current committed tests still encode the old behavior (e.g. expecting Datasets links to *not* carry `startTimeLabel`), so some will fail against the new logic — that's expected, since the verification system applies the updated test patch automatically.
